macro.overnight_read: Global equities and crypto are under persistent selling pressure with Bitcoin trading near $73,400 amid looming rate-hike concerns and crypto fear & greed at 32. The US Dollar Index remains strong at 121.88, while Treasury yields stay elevated with the 10-year at 4.86%, keeping risk assets on the defensive ahead of today's CPI release.
macro.summary: Markets are trading defensively with a strong US dollar and elevated Treasury yields weighing on tech, semiconductors, and crypto. With the CPI inflation print hitting today, we are prioritizing defensive sectors like healthcare and consumer staples while keeping risk appetite measured at 50. Playbooks should focus on mean reversion and macro/forex plays rather than aggressive momentum buying.
